_comment: Spotlight Now continuous daily driver configuration (renamed from Trendline Now 2026-11-24). Read by trendline/driver.sh and trendline/healthcheck.sh. Tunables only — no secrets here.

laptop._comment: Automatic laptop renders (2026-11-23): Rishi's Windows laptop (Hawkeye) is the ONLY renderer — the VM does code + orchestration only, never a render. enabled=false until the first live link test passes (Tailscale join approved + OpenSSH Server + VM public key in authorized_keys, then trendline/laptop-render.sh test). vm_render_fallback_enabled=false keeps the old VM render path OFF even while laptop mode is off, so the driver never silently renders on the VM while the link is being set up.

protected_job_note: Video #1, owned by the build subagent (intro/outro + TTS + art + assemble). The driver must NEVER touch this job directory. The loop is gated (state.json .paused=true) until video #1 finishes and Rishi reviews it.

queue_policy._comment: One video at a time, continuously. A completed video is recorded in state.json .completed and the next video starts on the next tick. NOTHING uploads automatically — sidecars are Approved:false and the uploader only touches approved videos. Rishi reviews each video before it is approved for upload.

render._comment: Scene-aligned chunks, 5 scenes each (~25-35 min). --concurrency=1: chunk renders OOM at concurrency 2 (2026-11-13 lesson). The landscape render (~20960 frames, ~6h at ~1fps) ALWAYS exceeds the 180-min Remotion timeout and the ~2-4h VM lifetime, so chunk recovery is the normal path for landscape, not an exception.
render.memory_gate_comment: Rishi 2026-11-23: block a render launch when free RAM is low or the machine has been up too long (driver.sh memory_gate_ok). Disabled until he switches it on. Thresholds from observed evidence: launches at ~150-250MB free died at frame ~58-96; vertical chunks that completed launched at ~782MB free, ~40-55 min after a restart; free decays to ~125MB within ~30 min of boot (seen 18:05 restart).

services._comment: Reachability probes (L15: a 401/403 from the unauthenticated probe means the endpoint is reachable and auth is required — a note, not a warning; a 429/500 or connection failure is still reported as unreachable). No quota is burned and no quota is checked: no quota endpoint reports remaining quota (see B31 note in the uploader).

tts._comment: Azure Free F0 throttles (HTTP 429) after ~20-35 rapid TTS calls. The pipeline paces calls 2s apart and the provider retries internally, but a hard throttle still kills the prep. The driver backs off then --resumes (each resume skips scenes already on disk).

_deprecated: prep_env was removed 2026-11-22 (fix sequence #2 ITEM 6, B10): driver.sh never read it, so editing it had zero effect. The live overrides are the GIGGLE_ScriptProvider / GIGGLE_SceneArtProvider exports in trendline/driver.sh. script_provider_env and scene_art_provider_env below are likewise documentation-only — no script reads them; keep them in sync with the driver.sh export by hand.
